Dual Boiler Espresso Machine Descaling Protocol:
- Frequency: Every 6 months when using filtered water at 50 ppm TDS.
- Descaling Solution: Dissolve 2 level tablespoons (approx 30g) of food-grade anhydrous citric acid powder per 1 liter of warm distilled water in the reservoir.
- Process:
  1. Empty both brew and steam boilers completely through the hot water tap and group head.
  2. Fill water reservoir with citric solution and power on to fill boilers.
  3. Allow boilers to reach operating temperature (93C brew, 125C steam), then turn off the machine and let the solution soak inside the copper/stainless tanks for 45 minutes.
  4. Flush group head 5 times (30 seconds each) and run 2 full tanks of clean filtered water to eliminate all citric residual before brewing espresso.
